title: 第一卷 第11章 比试第一卷 第12章 一轮不胜
lines: 陈玄看到林婉走过来，陈玄和车夫都连忙鞠躬道：“见过大夫人！”
林婉没有理会车夫，而是站在了陈玄的面前问道：“你为何会在此处。”
陈玄连忙道：“启禀大夫人，小人是跟随二夫人一起过来的。”
“跟随白浅浅一起过来的？”林婉的眉头皱起道。
“对，二夫人喜欢小人做的菜，小人如今是二夫人的私人厨子。”陈玄连忙道。
说着，他悄悄抬眼看了一眼林婉。
林婉依然平静的看着他，陈玄看不出她眼神之间的喜怒，他连忙低下了头。
而让陈玄感觉怪异的是，林婉只是站在他面前盯着她看了一阵，而后便转身离开了，这中间她居然什么都没说。
这让陈玄有些摸不准她的想法。
不多时，林婉在一个面容冰冷的丫鬟护送之下，走入到了前方的柳府之中。
“你是将军府的厨子？”就在陈玄心中有些忐忑之际，一个带着调侃的声音响了起来。
陈玄看了过去，他发现旁边那个中年男人，正看着他。
“是！”陈玄说道。
“哦？”这人上下打量着陈玄说道：“看来将军府的厨子，确实是拿不出手，你这种黄口小儿都被带过来了。”
从他第一句话，陈玄就看出了他的咄咄逼人，他挑眉看着对方道：“你是？”
“我乃钟显升，是王奎王相府上的主厨，来自青州！”对方傲然说道。
“哦！”陈玄道：“没听说过！”
钟显升嗤笑一声道：“你学厨未曾听说过我的名号，那你确实是白学了，我看你这副模样，怕不是因为厨艺，而是因为这副皮囊才成为的将军府二夫人的私人厨子的吧！”
听到这话，陈玄心里莫名有点儿心虚。
但是他却陡然看向了钟显升道：“将军府二夫人，也是你能够妄议的？”
钟显升却无所谓的耸了耸肩膀道：“小子，看来这将军府二夫人很看好你啊，竟然把你带过来了，都知道柳夫人喜好美食，不如咱们打个赌如何？”
“打赌？”陈玄饶有兴致的看着钟显升说道：“待会儿若是我们都进去了，咱们赌一赌，谁的菜更得夫人们的欢迎！”
“赌多少？”陈玄问道。
“五十两！”钟显升道：“敢么？”
“我有什么不敢的！”陈玄淡淡的道：“这个赌约，我接了！”
面对这个宛如美食荒漠一般的世界，陈玄不觉得自己有输的理由。
钟显升倒也没有怀疑陈玄拿不拿得出五十两，在他看来，作为将军府二夫人的私人厨子，自然是不缺这点儿银钱！
伴随着时间的流逝，一辆又一辆的角兽车不断的停靠着，一个个衣着华贵的妇人，也走入到了这柳府之中。
与此同时，柳府，大厅之间，十来名妇人正坐在其中，主位之上，一名三十几岁的女子正端着茶杯，笑眯眯的坐在那边！
“柳夫人！”就在这个时候，一名女子起身，她冲着主位上的女子微微行礼道：“前段时间，我从青州寻找到了一名厨子，号称厨艺能够在青州排名前三，他已经带着食材在府外候着了，不如今日晚宴就由她来做如何？”

When Chen Xuan saw Lin Wan approaching, Chen Xuan and the coachman both bowed quickly and said, "I've met the eldest lady!"
Lin Wan ignored the coachman, but stood in front of Chen Xuan and asked, "Why are you here."
Chen Xuan said quickly: "Madam Qi, I came here with the second lady."
"Did you come here with Bai Qianqian?" Lin Wan frowned.
"Yes, the second lady likes the dishes cooked by the villain. The villain is now the second lady's personal chef." Chen Xuan said quickly.
As he said that, he quietly raised his eyes and glanced at Lin Wan.
Lin Wan was still looking at him calmly. Chen Xuan couldn't see the joy or anger in her eyes, so he quickly lowered his head.
What made Chen Xuan feel weird was that Lin Wan just stood in front of him and stared at her for a while, then turned around and left. She didn't say anything during this time.
This made Chen Xuan a little unsure of her thoughts.
Not long after, Lin Wan was escorted by a maid with a cold face and walked into the Liu Mansion ahead.
"Are you the cook of the General's Mansion?" Just when Chen Xuan was feeling a little uneasy, a teasing voice rang out.
Chen Xuan looked over and found the middle-aged man next to him looking at him.
"Yes!" Chen Xuan said.
"Oh?" The man looked Chen Xuan up and down and said, "It seems that the cook in the General's Mansion really can't do anything. A kid like you has been brought here."
From his first words, Chen Xuan could see how aggressive he was. He raised his eyebrows and looked at the other person and said, "Who are you?"
"I am Zhong Xiansheng, the chef at Wang Kui's palace, from Qingzhou!" the other party said proudly.
"Oh!" Chen Xuandao: "I've never heard of it!"
Zhong Xiansheng sneered and said: "If you have never heard of my name when you learn cooking, then you have learned it in vain. I think it is not because of your cooking skills, but because of your appearance that you became the personal cook of the second wife of the General's Mansion!"
Hearing this, Chen Xuan felt a little guilty for no reason.
But he suddenly looked at Zhong Xiansheng and said: "The second lady of the General's Mansion, are you able to make such arrogant opinions?"
Zhong Xiansheng shrugged his shoulders indifferently and said: "Boy, it seems that the second wife of the General's Mansion is very optimistic about you, and she even brought you here. Everyone knows that Mrs. Liu likes delicious food, how about we make a bet?"
"Bet?" Chen Xuan looked at Zhong Xiansheng with interest and said, "If we all go in later, let's make a bet, whose dish is more popular with the ladies!"
"How much is the bet?" Chen Xuan asked.
"Fifty taels!" Zhong Xiansheng said, "Do you dare?"
"What am I afraid of!" Chen Xuan said calmly: "I will accept this bet!"
Facing this world that is like a food desert, Chen Xuan doesn't think he has any reason to lose.
Zhong Xiansheng did not doubt whether Chen Xuan could get fifty taels. In his opinion, as the personal cook of the second wife of the General's Mansion, he naturally had no shortage of such money!
As time went by, horned beast cars stopped one after another, and women in luxurious clothes also entered the Liu Mansion.
…
At the same time, in the Liu Mansion, in the hall, a dozen women were sitting, and above the main seat, a woman in her thirties was sitting there with a teacup and a smile!
"Mrs. Liu!" At this moment, a woman stood up. She slightly saluted the woman on the throne and said, "Some time ago, I found a cook from Qingzhou. He claims that his cooking skills can rank among the top three in Qingzhou. He is already waiting outside the house with the ingredients. How about she cook today's dinner?"
